workshoptitle: DB Security - Deep Data Security AI Demo Labs

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Review the independent AI demo labs, prerequisites, and suggested comparison order.

tutorials.title: Get Started
tutorials.description: Open and orient yourself in the Desktop environment.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Run a LangChain HR Agent with OCI IAM and Deep Data Security
tutorials.description: Create or reuse the OCI IAM and ADB setup, then compare LangChain results for two end users.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Run an OCI IAM-Protected Oracle SQL MCP Server
tutorials.description: Run the local Streamable HTTP MCP server and validate token-aware, read-only Oracle tools.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Configure the Reusable Python Oracle SQL MCP Server
tutorials.description: Configure an application-only MCP resource server against existing IAM, wallet, and Deep Data Security resources.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Run a Select AI Agent Team with Deep Data Security
tutorials.description: Create a Select AI profile and Agent Team, then run it through a token-attached database session.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Run LangChain HR and Compensation Agents with Microsoft Entra ID
tutorials.description: Compare Entra application-role and Oracle application-identity authorization paths in two LangChain agents.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving live help.
